newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares flat in higher turnover.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares flat in higher turnover.

text.p: 1040 GMT - Polish shares were flat in higher turnover after Monday's fall and selling was stronger after price fixing. * The main market's WIG index was flat at 16,245.2 points, the WIG 20 eased 0.2 percent to 1,597 points and the parallel market's WIRR rose 1.8 percent to 3,847.5. * Turnover rose eight percent to 164.8 million zlotys on all three markets as 47 issues rose, 29 fell and 22 were flat. Sell offers for 17 stocks and buy orders for seven were unmatched. Most active BIG was flat in a 10.1-million- zloty turnover. NFI units rose one percent in a 28.6-million-zloty turnover.
